detailed_descriptions_html.en:
🌍 The world once soared through the skies on wings of steel… until everything changed.

When disaster struck, the lucky ones bought property on remote islands, now the last remaining safe havens. Humanity clings to survival, scattered and struggling, with fragile network infrastructure barely held together by a few.

But life... goes on. Even in ruin.

✈️ You’ve found an abandoned plane

It's old. It's broken. But it’s yours. Scavenge the world for parts. Rebuild it. Fly between islands... or maybe beyond.

💻 In a world where real interaction is rare, the internet is your lifeline

Slow? Yes. Fragile? Definitely. But essential.
Your connection to the world is digital and vital:

  • Order plane parts online

  • Chat with clients and maybe friends

  • Browse post-apocalyptic websites

  • Manage your email

  • Pay your internet bills… if you want to stay connected

🧠 Monitor your needs and mental state

Stay sharp. Stay sober. Flying under the influence isn't just reckless, it's deadly.

👥 And the past?

It wasn’t as peaceful as you remember. Dark memories linger, haunting your every step. You’ll have to decide: run from them or face them.
